mapper.select: SELECT mwa.*, cp.id AS 'project.id', cp.serial_number AS 'project.serial_number', cp.short_name AS 'project.short_name', pm.id AS 'monomer.id', pm.name AS 'monomer.name', mbw.id AS 'workshop.id', mbw.name AS 'workshop.name', mbp.id AS 'process.id', mbp.name AS 'process.name', cu.id AS 'createUser.id', cu.name AS 'createUser.name', au.id AS 'approveUser.id', au.name AS 'approveUser.name', pi.quantity AS total_quantity, pi.weight AS total_weight FROM mes_wage_adjust mwa LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cp.id = mwa.project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND pm.id = mwa.monomer_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop mbw ON mbw.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbw.id = mwa.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON mbp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbp.id = mwa.process_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cu.id = mwa.create_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND au.id = mwa.approve_user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mwap.wage_adjust_id, sum( CASE mwap.product_type_enum WHEN ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} THEN artifact.quantity WHEN ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ASSEMBLE.getType()} THEN assemble.quantity WHEN ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@MACHINE_PART.getType()} THEN tmp.quantity END ) AS quantity, sum( CASE mwap.product_type_enum WHEN ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} THEN artifact.quantity * artifact.net_weight WHEN ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ASSEMBLE.getType()} THEN assemble.quantity * assemble.net_weight WHEN ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@MACHINE_PART.getType()} THEN tmp.quantity * tmp.net_weight END ) AS weight FROM mes_wage_adjust_product mwap LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON artifact.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mwap.product_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ARTIFACT.getType()} AND artifact.project_id = mwap.project_id AND artifact.monomer_id = mwap.monomer_id AND artifact.serial_number = mwap.product_serial_number LEFT JOIN tech_assemble assemble ON assemble.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mwap.product_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@ASSEMBLE.getType()} AND assemble.project_id = mwap.project_id AND assemble.monomer_id = mwap.monomer_id AND assemble.serial_number = mwap.product_serial_number LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part tmp ON tmp.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mwap.product_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.ProductTypeEnum@MACHINE_PART.getType()} AND tmp.project_id = mwap.project_id AND tmp.monomer_id = mwap.monomer_id AND tmp.serial_number = mwap.product_serial_number WHERE mwap.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY mwap.wage_adjust_id ) pi ON pi.wage_adjust_id = mwa.id WHERE mwa.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mwa.id = #{id}
